claims.claim_atom: In the original Figure 5C Source Data (v3), the Cbln12dcko cell 18 NMDAR-EPSC values (O43:S43 = 2.41868, 1.5132, 1.32901, 1.20165, 1.05549 across interstimulus intervals 20/80/200/800/2000 ms) are byte-identical to the Cbln12f/f cell 17 values (O19:S19). These are two DIFFERENT genotype conditions (double-conditional Cbln1/2 knockout vs floxed control), so identical per-interval values cannot be independent measurements. The authors acknowledged and eLife published a Correction (eLife 94305) stating cell 18 data were 'erroneously copy-pasted from cell 17 of the Cbln12f/f condition.'
claims._adjudication: 造假核心-作者+eLife已认(inconsistent): 原始v3中Cbln12dcko cell18(O43:S43)与Cbln12f/f cell17(O19:S19)5个ISI值逐位相同, 但两者不同基因型。eLife Correction 94305明确: cell18数据'erroneously copy-pasted from cell17 of Cbln12f/f'。v3→v4 diff证仅此5单元被改。verdict=inconsistent。

claims.claim_atom: The Cbln12dcko block is otherwise genuine: its cell 17 (O42:S42 = 1.26286, 1.23014, 0.859223, 0.882152, 0.975086) differs from the Cbln12f/f cell 17 (O19:S19), and the v3->v4 diff shows only the five cell-18 cells changed. The duplication was thus an isolated single-cell copy-paste during Source Data assembly, not wholesale fabrication of the condition; the authors state 'none of the corrections change the conclusions of the paper.'
claims._adjudication: 合法子断言(consistent): dcko区块除cell18外真实(cell17 O42:S42≠f/f cell17), v3→v4仅5单元变=孤立单细胞误粘, 非整条件编造。作者称不改结论。AI应把此定为孤立展示层错误。

claims.claim_atom: The corrected v4 cell-18 values (O43 = 2.62051, ...) are the authors' asserted true measurements, but because the raw electrophysiology traces are not deposited — and the parallel Figure 1B/1F/1G corrections describe values 'mistakenly copied from a previously analysed dataset that used different EPSC trace selection criteria', whose source is likewise not deposited — whether the corrected values are themselves the correct underlying measurements cannot be independently verified from the Source Data files alone.
claims._adjudication: 待定(insufficient): 更正后的v4 cell18值(2.62051...)是作者主张的真值, 但原始电生理trace未存, 且Fig1B/1F/1G更正涉及'copied from a previously analysed dataset with different criteria'的未存底材, 故更正值本身是否为真测量无法仅凭Source Data独立核验。verdict=insufficient。
